item.title: Lynn Montgomery: My 179 Nights in a Kyiv Airbnb
item.description: It is four years today, since Russia invaded Ukraine. This is the third and final in a series where I invite you to bear witness and experience the war, with Leona and me at the House of Swans. Much has changed since the beginning days when I booked my first nights and began this friendship with my remarkable host – a widowed mother, paramedic, and poet.
